scope: Full algebraic-curve image; k>=0, R nonzero of finite odd order; no asymptotic algorithmic gain claimed
statement: For a smooth elliptic curve over an algebraically closed field of characteristic p>3, a nonzero odd-order target R, and N=2^k, the functions D_N(x(P)) and D_N(x(R-P)) generate the full elliptic function field. Their irreducible image relation has exact bidegree (2N,2N). The written argument excludes bounded-bidegree scalar Dickson replacement only; it is not a circuit-size, finite-fibre solver or ECDLP lower bound, and has no Lean or signed PCC verdict.
